results.title: Every Premier League club's longest unbeaten run | FourFourTwo
results.content:
Manchester City's longest Premier League unbeaten run is 32 matches and extended from December 2023 to November 2024.

In the middle, they won the Premier League for the fourth consecutive season.

## Manchester United

Manchester United manager Alex Ferguson during the Intercontinental Cup final against Palmeiras in November 1999.

Alex Ferguson in 1999 (Image credit: Getty Images) [...] Leeds United famously went undefeated for 34 matches in the late sixties but their Premier League record is 14 matches unbeaten in the second season of the Premier League era.

That sequence started with five wins on the bounce as Leeds finished fifth.

## Tottenham Hotspur

Mauricio Pochettino File Photo

Tottenham Hotspur's Premier League record is also 14 matches unbeaten.

They've achieved that streak twice, once in 2015-16 and once in 2017-18. [...] (Image credit: Clive Rose/Getty Images)

Fulham are another club with a much longer unbeaten run elsewhere in their history but have an impressive Premier League streak of 9 matches too.

In the 2008-09 season, they managed three wins and six draws on the way to a top-seven finish.

results.title: The Longest Unbeaten Premier League Runs | Opta Analyst
results.content:
The longest unbeaten run in English top-flight history is held by Arsenal between May 2003 and October 2004, with Arsène Wenger’s Gunners side going a ridiculous 49 matches without a Premier League defeat.

38 of these 49 games came in a single season, as Arsenal’s ‘Invincibles’ went an entire campaign without defeat – the only Premier League team to ever do so – with a record of 24 wins and 12 draws. [...] ## Match Ticker

The Longest Unbeaten Premier League Runs

# The Longest Unbeaten Premier League Runs

There have only been 11 instances of teams going 30+ games unbeaten in English top-flight league history. Six of those have come in the Premier League era. We look back over each of those unbeaten runs.

### Arsenal: 49 Matches 7 May 2003 to 16 October 2004 [...] They continued that unbeaten run into 2024-25, but the streak eventually came to an end 33 games later, with City losing 1-0 to Bournemouth in November 2024. Overall, their run of 32 games without defeat is a top-flight club record.

### Arsenal: 30 Matches 23 December 2001 to 6 October 2002

Before Arsenal’s record-breaking 49-game unbeaten run in the Premier League, they had set a new club record 30 games without a defeat in between December 2001 and October 2002.

Before Arsenal went a whole season undefeated and established the Premier League’s longest unbeaten streak of 49 matches, they put together another remarkable run of consistency. It lasted 86 matches, with Jose Mourinho overseeing most of them (60).

He said: "There are some records that you look at and feel that it is impossible for somebody to do it. Our record from Chelsea is still the record and it is very difficult for somebody to do better than that." [...] Mourinho was speaking after Liverpool came up short in January 2021, when their bid to match Chelsea was halted by a shock 1-0 home defeat to Burnley.

Liverpool’s run, which began in May 2017, lasted 68 matches. Man City have the third longest streak of 37 matches from December 2010 to December 2012.

## 3 Chelsea – 40

### October 2004–October 2005

Chelsea celebrate

As one run ended, another began. The day after Arsenal's 49-game unbeaten run came to an end at Old Trafford, Chelsea started a long lossless stretch of their own. Jose Mourinho's side boasted a staggering defensive record, conceding just 19 goals across those 40 games, and kept an astonishing 24 clean sheets. [...] Despite their rotten luck, Avram Grant guided the club to an unbeaten run of 29 games. It was a thoroughly entertaining one, with a pair of 4-4 draws against Aston Villa and Tottenham Hotspur, as well as thumpings against West Ham United (4-0) and Derby County (6-1). Chelsea's unbeaten run came to an end at Anfield, losing 1-0 to Liverpool.

results.content:
The longest unbeaten away run in the football (soccer) English Premier League is 29 games, achieved by Manchester United (UK) between 17 February 2020 and 19 September 2021.

United won 19 and drew 10 matches during their unbeaten away streak. Their run finally came to an end on 16 October 2021, when they were defeated 4–2 at Leicester City. [...] en
